blocks.prompt: 5 A giant Ferris wheel has a diameter of 60 feet. The lowest point of the wheel is located 6 feet above the ground. The wheel completes one full revolution every 80 seconds. (a) Model an equation that represent the height \(h(t)\) of a rider on the Ferris wheel at any given time \(t\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh modelling ka sawal hai: diye gaye haqaiq se formula \(h(t) = a + b\cos(ct)\) banana hai.
Is ke liye centre ki unchai, radius aur \(c\) chahiye.
Plan: radius \(=\) diameter ka aadha; centre \(=\) sab se neecha point \(+\) radius; \(c = \frac{2\pi}{\text{period}}\); aur rider neeche se shuru karta hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: diameter 60 ft, sab se neecha point zameen se 6 ft upar, ek chakkar 80 second mein.
Humein find karna hai: \(h(t)\) ka formula.
Tareeqa: Ghoomte pahiye par seat ki unchai \(= \text{centre} \pm \text{radius} \times \cos(\ldots)\). Hum maante hain ke \(t = 0\) par rider sab se neeche wale point par seat par baithta hai (sawal yeh nahi batata, magar yahi aam farz hai aur key bhi yahi leti hai). Is liye \(-\cos\) lenge, jo apni sab se chhoti value se shuru hota hai.

Radius (amplitude)
\[r = \tfrac{60}{2} = 30 \text{ ft}\]
Kyun: Rider centre se 30 ft upar aur 30 ft neeche tak jata hai. Yahi wave ka amplitude hai.

Centre ki unchai (midline)
\[a = 6 + 30 = 36 \text{ ft}\]
Kyun: Sab se neecha point centre se ek radius neeche hota hai. Is liye centre \(= 6 + 30 = 36\) ft. Wave isi line ke ird gird upar neeche hoti hai.

Angular speed \(c\)
\[c = \dfrac{2\pi}{80} = \dfrac{\pi}{40}\]
Kyun: Ek poora chakkar \(2\pi\) radian hai aur woh 80 second mein hota hai. \(\cos(ct)\) ka period \(\frac{2\pi}{c}\) hota hai, use 80 ke barabar rakha to \(c = \frac{\pi}{40}\).

Model likhein
\[h(t) = 36 - 30\cos\left(\tfrac{\pi}{40}t\right)\]
Kyun: \(t = 0\) par \(\cos 0 = 1\), to \(h = 36 - 30 = 6\): rider bilkul neeche se shuru karta hai. Agar \(+\cos\) likhte to rider choti (66 ft) se shuru hota, jo sawal ke halaat se mel nahi khata.

Tasdeeq
\[h(0) = 36 - 30 = 6 \;\checkmark\]
\[h(40) = 36 - 30\cos\pi = 66 \;\checkmark\]
\[h(80) = 6 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Shuru mein sab se neeche, aadhe chakkar (40 s) par sab se upar, aur poore chakkar (80 s) ke baad phir neeche. Model bilkul pahiye ki tarah chal raha hai.

blocks.prompt: 5 A giant Ferris wheel has a diameter of 60 feet. The lowest point of the wheel is located 6 feet above the ground. The wheel completes one full revolution every 80 seconds. (b) Find the maximum height of a rider.
blocks.explanation:
Pahiye ka sab se ooncha point.
Humein \(h(t)\) ki sab se bari value chahiye.
Plan: model mein \(-1 \le \cos \le 1\) lagana.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(h(t) = 36 - 30\cos\left(\tfrac{\pi}{40}t\right)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(h\) ka maximum.
Tareeqa: Cosine \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke beech rehta hai. Cosine ke saath minus sign hai, is liye cosine \(-1\) ho to \(h\) sab se bara.

Cosine wale hisse ki range
\[-1 \le \cos\left(\tfrac{\pi}{40}t\right) \le 1\]
\[30 \ge -30\cos\left(\tfrac{\pi}{40}t\right) \ge -30\]
Kyun: \(-30\) se multiply kiya; negative number se multiply karne par inequality ke nishan ulat jate hain.

36 jama karein
\[66 \ge h(t) \ge 6\]
Kyun: 36 centre ki unchai hai. Ab saaf dikhta hai ke rider 6 ft se 66 ft ke darmiyan rehta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[h(40) = 36 - 30(-1) = 66\]
\[\text{Top} = 6 + 60 = 66 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Doosre tareeqe se: sab se neecha point 6 ft hai aur pahiye ki poori unchai (diameter) 60 ft, to choti \(6 + 60 = 66\) ft. Dono tareeqe ek hi jawab dete hain.

blocks.prompt: 5 A giant Ferris wheel has a diameter of 60 feet. The lowest point of the wheel is located 6 feet above the ground. The wheel completes one full revolution every 80 seconds. (c) Find the height of the rider from the ground after 35 seconds.
blocks.explanation:
Part (a) wale model mein value rakhni hai.
Humein \(h(35)\) chahiye.
Plan: angle \(\frac{35\pi}{40}\) nikalna, us ka cosine, phir \(h\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(h(t) = 36 - 30\cos\left(\tfrac{\pi}{40}t\right)\), \(t = 35\).
Humein find karna hai: 35 second baad rider ki unchai \(h(35)\).
Tareeqa: Value rakhenge; \(\frac{7\pi}{8} = 157.5^{\circ}\) doosre quadrant (Quadrant II) mein hai jahan cosine negative hota hai.

Angle nikalein
\[\tfrac{\pi}{40}(35) = \tfrac{7\pi}{8} = 157.5^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{35}{40} = \frac{7}{8}\), aur \(\frac{7}{8} \times 180^{\circ} = 157.5^{\circ}\). Degrees mein dekhne se quadrant foran samajh aata hai.

Cosine nikalein
\[\cos 157.5^{\circ} = -\cos 22.5^{\circ}\]
\[\approx -0.92388\]
Kyun: \(\cos(180^{\circ} - \theta) = -\cos\theta\): Quadrant II mein cosine negative hai. \(180^{\circ} - 157.5^{\circ} = 22.5^{\circ}\).

\(h\) nikalein
\[h(35) = 36 - 30(-0.92388)\]
\[= 36 + 27.716\]
\[\approx 63.72 \text{ ft}\]
Kyun: Minus aur negative milkar plus ban gaye: \(-30 \times (-0.92388) = +27.716\).
Dhyan dein: Yahan sign ki ghalti se \(36 - 27.72 = 8.28\) ft aa jata hai, jo ghalat hai.

Tasdeeq
\[6 \le 63.72 \le 66 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 35 second choti (40 second) se zara pehle hai, is liye rider 66 ft se thora neeche hona chahiye, aur 63.72 ft yahi dikhata hai. Graph mein bhi point \((35, 63.72)\) choti ke qareeb hai.
